summary: saturn-bail ships a Baileys fork with a char-code-obfuscated exfiltration host
details: lib/Socket/messages-send.js contains a String.fromCharCode(...) array that decodes to the hardcoded host https://fiora.nixel.my.id/. The destination is reconstructed from a numeric char-code array rather than appearing as a plain string, which is an obfuscation pattern used to hide exfiltration endpoints from casual review. The package is a fork of the WhatsApp Baileys library, whose messages-send path handles session/credential and message material; an obfuscated third-party host embedded in that path is inconsistent with the library's documented functionality and matches the shape of active-attack exfiltration in similar Baileys forks.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
